claims: Olivia Rodrigo has announced her third studio album “You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love”
Olivia Rodrigo's third studio album “You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love” is set for release on June 12, 2026
Olivia Rodrigo's third studio album “You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love” is set for release via Geffen Records
Olivia Rodrigo's third studio album “You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love” is produced by Dan Nigro
Olivia Rodrigo's third studio album “You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love” follows her previous successes SOUR and GUTS
The lead single “Drop Dead” is released on April 17, 2026
